review.notes: Full re-review. Previous R01, R02, R04 repaired; R03 locators repaired (no sources.toml exists on any main roadmap, so that part is not re-raised). Gate at this head passes every scanner, the dependency check (208 roadmaps, 1452 edges, 0 problems, rerun) and the targeted build; direct elaboration exits 0 with four sorry warnings; #check of all nine declarations keeps every binder. One-tactic probes (simp, rfl, infer_instance, exact?, aesop) fail on all four admitted headlines. Seeded sample verified at the text: benedettilisca2018 Thm 1 p.1 and section 2.1 pp.2-3; atiyah1971 Prop 4.1 and Thm 3' p.58; miller Defs 1.1-1.2 p.2, Thm 11.2 p.30, Ch.2 Defs 1.1/1.3 and Thm 1.4 pp.39-41; milnorstasheff1974 section 16.3 p.194, Problems 16-C-F pp.203-204, Lemma 17.2 p.207, Thm 11.14; thom1954 IV.6 p.74, IV.8 p.75, IV.17 p.84; fuhring2022, kreckstolz1993, rosenbergstolz, baez2002, guillouweibel2013 and pyronneau2024 reopened at their locators. Lee 2013 is paywalled (uncertified). Two blocking findings: StringOrientation (earlier in the merge order, open head) already plans the structured and framed Pontryagin-Thom coefficient theorems, pi_3 S and the odd-primary Spin/SO comparison (S2.2, S2.3, S5.3) and the Cayley plane with its characteristic classes and String-lift uniqueness (S1.5); this roadmap re-plans them and its Scope claims StringOrientation consumes them, which its head does not. One P3: a backticked own Lean name not declared in Suggested.lean. Adversarial table of 70 computed rows, including exhaustive Arf enumeration in dimensions 0, 2, 4 and the Clifford volume sign recomputed with the supplier's Cayley-Dickson product. One source error recorded (Milnor-Stasheff p.194 fibre).
